company.name: Pyroscope
company.shortDescription: Pyroscope is an open-source profiling program that can use to troubleshoot performance problems.
company.description:
Pyroscope is an open-source tool for continuous profiling. 

It will help debug performance problems and identify bottlenecks in a code.

Pyroscope was founded in 2020 and is located in Oakland, California.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source continuous profiling tool that collects and analyzes application performance data to identify CPU and memory usage issues.
productsAndServices.name: Pyroscope Open Source Continuous Profiling Platform

productsAndServices.description: A managed cloud service for continuous profiling that integrates with Grafana Cloud to provide scalable and secure profiling data storage and analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Pyroscope Cloud (Grafana Cloud Profiles)

productsAndServices.description: A query engine that enables custom queries and aggregation of profiling data for efficient performance analysis.
productsAndServices.name: FlameQL Query Engine

productsAndServices.description: Agents that collect profiling data with minimal impact on application performance, supporting multiple programming languages.
productsAndServices.name: Low-overhead Profiling Agents

productsAndServices.description: Links profiling data with OpenTelemetry tracing to provide request- or span-specific performance profiles.
productsAndServices.name: Profile Exemplars Integration

productsAndServices.description: Integrations with observability tools like Honeycomb, Jaeger, Grafana, AWS Lambda, Prometheus, and Slack to enhance profiling data usage.
productsAndServices.name: Pyroscope Integrations
